text:
Baseline reuse should not depend on origin/HEAD. The first job after the baseline-reuse fix re-ran the full local baseline with 'origin/HEAD is not set, so the default branch is not read'; a fresh clone has no origin/HEAD. When origin/HEAD is missing, use the default branch Athena already lands to (main) to find the green CI result.

Acceptance:
- a test where origin/HEAD is unset and main has a green CI result for the base's governed content: the baseline is reused
- the existing baseline-reuse tests still pass
